summary: Newbury Street II Acquisition Corp (SPAC) filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, announcing a merger agreement with Fort Robotics. The SPAC will domesticate from Cayman Islands to Delaware, then its wholly-owned subsidiary (Merger Sub) will merge with Fort Robotics, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Fort Robotics stockholders will receive their pro rata share of the Stockholder Merger Consideration based on the SPAC's trust account. This is a de-SPAC transaction representing an acquisition by the SPAC (issuer). The filing includes the merger agreement as Exhibit 2.1, forming a key catalyst for the business combination. Watch for shareholder approval and redemptions.
